name: phase05f-iteration58b-ans-device
behavior_before: No QEMU device models the /arm-io/ans MMIO ranges; all guest accesses to ANS registers fault silently.
behavior_after: apple-ans sysbus device maps the DT reg entries at iobase and logs reads/writes. COPROC_CPU_CONTROL (0x44) is stored, BOOT_STATUS (0x1300) returns 0xde71ce55 (always booted). No mailbox, interrupt, or NVMe protocol behavior is claimed.

acceptance.boot_regression: Kernel boots with same serial progress as control (no new panics).
acceptance.ans_mmio_mapped: stderr contains apple-ans: mmio[N] mapped for all 7 nonzero DT reg entries.
acceptance.honest_failure: Zero MMIO reads/writes observed in v4/v5 runs; ANS driver does not probe. This is recorded as the open blocker, not claimed as success.

open_blocker: AppleANS3 requires RTBuddyService(role=ANS2), published by AppleASCWrapV6 which matches AppleARMIODevice via IONameMatch iop,ascwrap-v6/v7. Runtime evidence: 40+ AppleARMIODevice allocations but zero ASCWrap starts. The ARM platform expert kext (com.apple.driver.AppleARMPlatform) controls arm-io child nub creation via closed-source excludeList/deleteList; whether /arm-io/ans receives a nub is the next required proof.
notes: 58B is QEMU device infrastructure only. No RTBuddy attach, mailbox exchange, NVMe admin queue, namespace publication, or storage functionality is claimed.
